nodes.Name: Tree
nodes.DocComment: Tree is the representation of a single parsed template.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.DocComment: name of the template represented by the tree.

Fields.Name: ParseName
Fields.DocComment: name of the top-level template during parsing, for error messages.

Fields.Name: text
Fields.DocComment: text parsed to create the template (or its parent)

Fields.Name: actionLine
Fields.DocComment: line of left delim starting action

nodes.Name: Mode
nodes.DocComment: A Mode value is a set of flags (or 0). Modes control parser behavior.

nodes.Name: maxStackDepth
nodes.DocComment:
maxStackDepth is the maximum depth permitted for nested
parenthesized expressions.

nodes.Name: init
nodes.DocComment: init reduces maxStackDepth for WebAssembly due to its smaller stack size.

nodes.Name: Copy
nodes.DocComment: Copy returns a copy of the [Tree]. Any parsing state is discarded.

nodes.Name: Parse
nodes.DocComment:
Parse returns a map from template name to [Tree], created by parsing the
templates described in the argument string. The top-level template will be
given the specified name. If an error is encountered, parsing stops and an
empty map is returned with the error.

nodes.Name: next
nodes.DocComment: next returns the next token.

nodes.Name: backup
nodes.DocComment: backup backs the input stream up one token.

nodes.Name: backup2
nodes.DocComment:
backup2 backs the input stream up two tokens.
The zeroth token is already there.

nodes.Name: backup3
nodes.DocComment:
backup3 backs the input stream up three tokens
The zeroth token is already there.

nodes.Name: peek
nodes.DocComment: peek returns but does not consume the next token.

nodes.Name: nextNonSpace
nodes.DocComment: nextNonSpace returns the next non-space token.

nodes.Name: peekNonSpace
nodes.DocComment: peekNonSpace returns but does not consume the next non-space token.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment: New allocates a new parse tree with the given name.

nodes.Name: ErrorContext
nodes.DocComment:
ErrorContext returns a textual representation of the location of the node in the input text.
The receiver is only used when the node does not have a pointer to the tree inside,
which can occur in old code.

nodes.Name: errorf
nodes.DocComment: errorf formats the error and terminates processing.

nodes.Name: error
nodes.DocComment: error terminates processing.

nodes.Name: expect
nodes.DocComment: expect consumes the next token and guarantees it has the required type.

nodes.Name: expectOneOf
nodes.DocComment: expectOneOf consumes the next token and guarantees it has one of the required types.

nodes.Name: unexpected
nodes.DocComment: unexpected complains about the token and terminates processing.

nodes.Name: recover
nodes.DocComment: recover is the handler that turns panics into returns from the top level of Parse.

nodes.Name: startParse
nodes.DocComment: startParse initializes the parser, using the lexer.

nodes.Name: stopParse
nodes.DocComment: stopParse terminates parsing.

nodes.Name: Parse
nodes.DocComment:
Parse parses the template definition string to construct a representation of
the template for execution. If either action delimiter string is empty, the
default ("{{" or "}}") is used. Embedded template definitions are added to
the treeSet map.

nodes.Name: add
nodes.DocComment: add adds tree to t.treeSet.

nodes.Name: IsEmptyTree
nodes.DocComment: IsEmptyTree reports whether this tree (node) is empty of everything but space or comments.

nodes.Name: parse
nodes.DocComment:
parse is the top-level parser for a template, essentially the same
as itemList except it also parses {{define}} actions.
It runs to EOF.

nodes.Name: parseDefinition
nodes.DocComment:
parseDefinition parses a {{define}} ...  {{end}} template definition and
installs the definition in t.treeSet. The "define" keyword has already
been scanned.

nodes.Name: itemList
nodes.DocComment:
itemList:

	textOrAction*

Terminates at {{end}} or {{else}}, returned separately.

nodes.Name: textOrAction
nodes.DocComment:
textOrAction:

	text | comment | action

nodes.Name: action
nodes.DocComment:
Action:

	control
	command ("|" command)*

Left delim is past. Now get actions.
First word could be a keyword such as range.

nodes.Name: breakControl
continueControl
pipeline
nodes.DocComment:
Pipeline:

	declarations? command ('|' command)*

Children.Name: case
Children.RawSource: itemBool, itemCharConstant, itemComplex, itemDot, itemField, itemIdentifier, itemNumber, itemNil, itemRawString, itemString, itemVariable, itemLeftParen

nodes.Name: ifControl
rangeControl
withControl
endControl
elseControl
blockControl
nodes.DocComment:
Block:

	{{block stringValue pipeline}}

Block keyword is past.
The name must be something that can evaluate to a string.
The pipeline is mandatory.

nodes.Name: templateControl
nodes.DocComment:
Template:

	{{template stringValue pipeline}}

Template keyword is past. The name must be something that can evaluate
to a string.

nodes.Name: command
nodes.DocComment:
command:

	operand (space operand)*

space-separated arguments up to a pipeline character or right delimiter.
we consume the pipe character but leave the right delim to terminate the action.

nodes.Name: operand
nodes.DocComment:
operand:

	term .Field*

An operand is a space-separated component of a command,
a term possibly followed by field accesses.
A nil return means the next item is not an operand.

nodes.Name: term
nodes.DocComment:
term:

	literal (number, string, nil, boolean)
	function (identifier)
	.
	.Field
	$
	'(' pipeline ')'

A term is a simple "expression".
A nil return means the next item is not a term.

nodes.Name: hasFunction
nodes.DocComment: hasFunction reports if a function name exists in the Tree's maps.

nodes.Name: popVars
nodes.DocComment: popVars trims the variable list to the specified length

nodes.Name: useVar
nodes.DocComment:
useVar returns a node for a variable reference. It errors if the
variable is not defined.
